summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would end the Regional Forest Agreements framework and remove its exemptions from federal environmental assessment and approval requirements for forestry operations.
It would repeal the Regional Forest Agreements Act 2002, terminate current agreements and require annual statements on native logging's effects on conservation commitments.
The main provisions would start the day after Royal Assent, with annual statement requirements applying from the first 30 June on or after commencement.
changes: Export controls would apply to wood previously covered by regional agreements.
The Commonwealth would owe reasonable compensation for any acquisition of property otherwise than on just terms.
The minister would report on logging's effect on conserving at least 30 per cent of Australian land by 2030.
summary.affected: Native forest logging operators, state governments, the federal environment minister and the Threatened Species Commissioner are affected.
